blocks.text: Organ pipe wind instrument (hawa se bajne wala saaz) hai jis mein hawa ke column mein stationary waves banne se sound (awaz) paida hoti hai. Yeh ek lambi hollow (khokhli) tube hai jis ke dono sire khule hote hain, ya ek sira khula aur doosra band. Aane wali (incident) aur palatne wali (reflected) wave ka relation (taalluq) is par depend karta hai ke pipe ka reflect karne wala sira khula hai ya band.

items: (i) Agar reflect karne wala sira khula ho to hawa ke molecules poori freedom (azaadi) se hil sakte hain, aur yeh sira antinode ban jata hai.
(ii) Agar reflect karne wala sira band ho to yeh node ban jata hai, kyunke wahan molecules ki motion (harkat) ruki hui hai.
